The petitioner before this Court is seeking an anticipatory bail, which was declined by the High Court by an order dated 20.07.2023.
The petitioner is an accused for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and is facing investigation.
Vide order dated 16.12.2024, interim protection was granted to the petitioner, subject to cooperation in the investigation.
In the counter affidavit filed by the State, it has been categorically stated in paragraph 12 that nothing adverse is found against the petitioner.

Paragraph 12 reads as under :-

sentences.text: That from the record, it is  verified that nothing adverse is found  against the petitioner and further  investigation is pending due to the  petitioner.
Under these circumstances, having considered the entire facts of the matter, we do not think that this is a case where custodial interrogation of the petitioner is required.
But this would not mean that the petitioner will stop cooperating with the ongoing investigation.
The petitioner shall respond to the Investigating Officer and shall visit the Police Station as and when he is required.

However,
under the circumstances, we are of the opinion that the petitioner is entitled for an anticipatory bail.

In the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with FIR No. 154 of 2023 registered at Baliapal Police Station, Dist. Baleshwar, Orissa, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.
